metadata.name: Compliance Global Admin
metadata.description: Compliance administration for a central compliance team. Can create, update and delete GLOBAL compliance schemas, and read every database's compliance schemas, evaluation state, history, audit log and cascades. Cannot bind schemas, trigger evaluations, release quarantined assets, approve cascades, or write any asset or database. Can run the GLOBAL workflows (execute route and read of the workflow and its pipelines only), so it can save pipeline rules that name them; a GLOBAL schema naming a database's workflow needs that database's run rights from another role.

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-api-routes-get
constraints.description: Allow read-only API access to compliance endpoints

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-api-routes-post
constraints.description: Allow the login profile and route checks

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-schema-api-routes
constraints.description: Allow API access to register, update and delete schemas

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-database-list-route
constraints.description: Allow listing databases (the database compliance pages link from it)

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-schemas-global
constraints.description: Allow management of GLOBAL compliance schemas

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-schemas-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read of every database's compliance schemas

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-evaluations-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read of compliance state, history and audit in every database

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-compliance-cascades-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read of every database's cascades

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-database-readonly
constraints.description: Allow read of every database (names and bindings)

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-workflow-execute-route
constraints.description: Run a workflow through its execute route only (POST /workflows/{workflowDatabaseId}/{workflowId}/execute), so a pipeline rule naming it can be saved. Matches no workflow create, update, archive or re-run route.

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-workflows-run-global
constraints.description: Read the workflows of GLOBAL (no create, edit or delete), as running a workflow requires

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-pipelines-run-global
constraints.description: Read the pipelines of GLOBAL (no create, edit or delete), as running a workflow requires
